* AAC Sixth Man of the Year (2018) }} '''Armoni Daetrell Brooks''' (born June 5, 1998) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Valencia Basket]] of the [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroLeague]], on loan from [[ASVEL Basket|ASVEL Lyon-Villeurbanne]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston Cougars]]. ==College career== Brooks attended [[McNeil High School]] in [[Austin, Texas]], where he played basketball. Lightly recruited out of high school, he enrolled at the [[University of Houston]] to play for the [[Houston Cougars men's basketball]] team under head coach [[Kelvin Sampson]].{{cite news |last1=Reiss |first1=Aaron |title='I want a guy that people fear': Inside the continued transformation of Houston's Armoni Brooks |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/798663/2019/02/04/armoni-brooks-houston-cougars-kelvin-sampson-transformation/ |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=The Athletic|issue=subscription |date=February 4, 2019}}{{cite news |last1=Creech |first1=Jenny Dial |title=Once overlooked by colleges, Armoni Brooks now on the rise at UH |url=https://www.houstonchronicle.com/sports/texas-sports-nation/jenny-dial-creech/article/Once-overlooked-by-colleges-Armoni-Brooks-now-on-13726550.php |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=Houston Chronicle |date=March 29, 2019}} As a junior, Brooks posted 13.4 points and 6.3 rebounds in 30.7 minutes per game. He was named to the All-[[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] Second Team and All-AAC Tournament Team. Brooks declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]], and lost his final year of eligibility for college basketball.{{cite news |last1=Whiting |first1=Trenton |title=Talent, coaching makes up for Brooks' departure |url=http://thedailycougar.com/2019/06/04/talent-coaching-brooks-departure/ |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=The Daily Cougar |date=June 4, 2019}}{{cite news |last1=Duarte |first1=Joseph |title=UH guard Armoni Brooks remaining in NBA draft |url=https://www.chron.com/sports/cougars/article/UH-guard-Armoni-Brooks-remaining-in-NBA-draft-13903844.php |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=Houston Chronicle |date=May 29, 2019}} Prior to the draft, Brooks' shooting ability was considered his best asset.{{cite news |last1=Whiting |first1=Trenton |title=Will Davis and Brooks hear their names called in the NBA Draft? |url=http://thedailycougar.com/2019/06/18/davis-brooks-nba-draft-2019/ |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=The Daily Cougar |date=June 18, 2019}} ==Professional career== ===College Park Skyhawks (2019–2020)=== [[File:Armoni Brooks.jpg|thumb|150 px|left|Brooks with the [[College Park Skyhawks]] in 2019]] After going undrafted in the [[2019 NBA draft]], Brooks played with the [[Washington Wizards]] in the [[2019 NBA Summer League]].{{cite news |last1=Romero |first1=Jhair |title=Davis, Brooks sign with Wizards as undrafted free agents |url=http://thedailycougar.com/2019/06/21/davis-brooks-undrafted-free-agents/ |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=The Daily Cougar |date=June 21, 2019}}{{cite news |title=Wizards announce 2019 Summer League roster |url=https://www.nba.com/wizards/wizards-announce-2019-summer-league-roster |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=NBA.com |date=July 3, 2019}} In August 2019, he signed with the [[Atlanta Hawks]],{{cite news |title=Atlanta Hawks Sign Armoni Brooks |url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/atlanta-hawks-sign-armoni-brooks |access-date=October 1, 2019 |work=NBA.com |date=August 27, 2019}} but was waived on October 18.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/atlanta-hawks-request-waivers-brooks-derrickson-mccall-and-sibert|title = Atlanta Hawks Request Waivers on Brooks, Derrickson, McCall and Sibert|website = [[NBA.com]]}} He was subsequently rostered on the Hawks' [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[College Park Skyhawks]].{{cite web |title=College Park Skyhawks Announce Training Camp Roster |url=https://cpskyhawks.gleague.nba.com/news/college-park-skyhawks-announce-training-camp-roster/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=November 17, 2019 |date=October 29, 2019 |archive-date=November 17, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191117202538/https://cpskyhawks.gleague.nba.com/news/college-park-skyhawks-announce-training-camp-roster/ |url-status=dead }} On January 24, 2020, Brooks scored a career-high 38 points against the [[Lakeland Magic]] and four days later, he scored 32 points against the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]]. Throughout the season, he averaged 10.7 points and 3.4 rebounds for the Skyhawks. On April 20, 2020, Brooks signed with the [[Saskatchewan Rattlers]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]].{{cite web |title=Saskatchewan Rattlers Announce Signing of Armoni Brooks |url=https://www.therattlers.ca/saskatchewan-rattlers-announce-signing-of-armoni-brooks |website=Saskatchewan Rattlers |access-date=June 20, 2020 |date=April 20, 2020}} However, he never played for the Rattlers, as he sat out the season due to the COVID-19 pandemic.{{cite news |last1=Mason |first1=Jala |title=From Round Rock to the pros: former UH guard Armoni Brooks' journey pursuing his dream |url=http://thedailycougar.com/2020/10/19/former-uh-guard-armoni-brooks-journey-pursuing-his-dream/ |access-date=October 20, 2020 |work=The Daily Cougar |date=October 19, 2020}} ===Rio Grande Valley Vipers (2021)=== On January 11, 2021, Brooks was selected by the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] in the first round of the NBA G League draft.{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/nba-g-league-2020-21-draft-order/|title=NBA G League 2020-21 Draft Results|work=gleague.nba.com|date=January 8, 2021|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210115153522/https://gleague.nba.com/nba-g-league-2020-21-draft-order/|archive-date=January 15, 2021}} In 15 games during the [[2020–21 NBA G League season|G League hub season]], he averaged 16.8 points, 3.7 rebounds, 3.0 assists, and 1.07 steals while leading the G League in 3-pointers made (57), averaging 3.8 on 37.5 percent shooting.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/rockets-sign-armoni-brooks-two-way-contract|title=Rockets Sign Armoni Brooks to Two-Way Contract|date=April 3, 2021|website=NBA.com|access-date=April 4, 2021}} ===Houston Rockets (2021–2022)=== [[File:Armoni Brooks 2021.jpg|thumb|150 px|left|Brooks with the [[Houston Rockets]] in 2021]] On April 3, 2021, Brooks signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Vipers' NBA affiliate, the [[Houston Rockets]]. He scored a career-high 24 points in a May 12 loss to the [[Los Angeles Lakers]]. On August 27, 2021, Brooks re-signed with the Rockets on a four-year contract.{{cite web |title=Rockets Re-Sign Armoni Brooks |url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-re-sign-armoni-brooks |website=NBA.com |access-date=August 28, 2021 |date=August 27, 2021}} He was waived on February 10, 2022.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-complete-four-player-trade-boston|website=nba.com|title=Rockets Complete Four Player Trade with Boston|access-date=February 10, 2022|date=February 10, 2022}} ===Return to College Park (2022)=== On February 27, 2022, Brooks was re-acquired by the [[College Park Skyhawks]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|date=February 27, 2022|access-date=February 27, 2022}} ===Toronto Raptors (2022)=== On March 6, 2022, Brooks signed a 10-day contract with the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{cite web|title=Raptors sign guard Armoni Brooks to 10-day contract, release D.J. Wilson|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/raptors-sign-guard-armoni-brooks-to-10-day-contract-release-d-j-wilson/|website=Sportsnet.ca|date=March 7, 2022|access-date=March 7, 2022}} On March 16, he signed a second 10-day contract.{{cite web|title=Raptors sign Armoni Brooks to another 10-day contract|url=https://www.nba.com/news/raptors-sign-armoni-brooks-to-2nd-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=March 16, 2022|access-date=March 17, 2022}} On March 26, he signed a two-year deal with the Raptors.{{cite tweet|author=Toronto Raptors|number=1507747906748624899|title=Officially official @snipabrooks_ #WeTheNorth|user=Raptors|date=March 26, 2022|access-date=March 26, 2022}}{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Raptors Sign Armoni Brooks To Two-Year 2022.{{cite web|first=Mike|last=Luciano|title= Raptors waive Armoni Brooks after brief tenure in Toronto|url= https://raptorsrapture.com/2022/07/30/raptors-waive-armoni-brooks/|website=FanSided.com|date=July 30, 2022|access-date=July 31, 2022}} ===Third stint with College Park (2022–2023)=== On November 4, 2022-23|date=November 3, 2022|access-date=November 3, 2022}} ===Brooklyn / Long Island Nets (2023–2024)=== On July 18, 2023, Brooks signed a two-way contract with the [[Brooklyn Nets]].{{cite
